title: 12 Best Seafood Restaurants in Kota Kinabalu (2026)
description: The best seafood restaurants in Kota Kinabalu, Malaysia

places.name: Welcome Seafood Restaurant
places.address: Lot G 18, Kompleks Asia City Phase 2A, 88300 KK

redditQuotes.text: Welcome Seafood is always the first recommendation for KK seafood. Huge portions, fresh tanks.
Touristy but for good reason. The butter prawns are addictive.

places.verdict: The most famous seafood restaurant in KK — a bustling institution with live tanks and an enormous menu.

comparison.best for: Wide variety of fresh seafood in a lively atmosphere
comparison.strengths: Massive menu · Live tanks · Muslim-friendly · 7,300+ reviews
comparison.limitations: Packed and noisy · Touristy prices · Closed Fri–Sun
comparison.what to order: Butter prawns, kam heong crab, steamed fish with soy sauce.

places.whatToOrder: Butter prawns, kam heong crab, steamed fish with soy sauce.

places.name: Fatt Kee Seafood Restaurant
places.address: Lorong Hilltop, Taman Far East, 88300 KK

redditQuotes.text: Fatt Kee’s fish noodle soup is legendary. Fresh fish slices in perfectly seasoned broth.
Popular with locals for quick meals. Generous portions, best value seafood.

places.verdict: A 20-year local favorite — the legendary fish noodle soup alone is worth the trip.

comparison.best for: Budget-friendly seafood noodles and classic Chinese cooking
comparison.strengths: Open from breakfast · 5,800+ reviews · Famous fish noodle soup
comparison.limitations: Basic decor · Very crowded at lunch
comparison.what to order: Fish noodle soup (signature), Tom Yam seafood soup, stir-fried clams.

places.whatToOrder: Fish noodle soup (signature), Tom Yam seafood soup, stir-fried clams.

places.name: KK Garden Seafood Gaya Restaurant

redditQuotes.text: KK Garden is a sound choice downtown. Large outdoor place with fresh seafood.
Right on Gaya Street — perfect for tourists wanting quality seafood near city center.

places.verdict: Highest-rated seafood in downtown KK — spacious outdoor seating, live tanks, fresh catches.

comparison.best for: High-quality downtown seafood with aquarium display
comparison.strengths: 4.5★ · Large outdoor area · Fresh live tanks · Gaya Street
comparison.limitations: Pricier than suburban spots · Busy weekends
comparison.what to order: Salted egg squid, sweet and sour crab, fresh oysters.

places.whatToOrder: Salted egg squid, sweet and sour crab, fresh oysters.

places.name: Kampung Nelayan Floating Restaurant

redditQuotes.text: Kampung Nelayan is more than food — floating setting, cultural dances, fresh seafood are unforgettable.
Great for families. Lakeside setting is magical at night.

places.verdict: One-of-a-kind floating restaurant — dine lakeside with nightly cultural performances.

comparison.best for: Unique floating experience with Sabah cultural shows
comparison.strengths: Halal · Cultural shows · Garden setting · BBQ steamboat
comparison.limitations: Higher prices · Touristy · Outside city center
comparison.what to order: BBQ steamboat buffet, grilled stingray, seafood platter.

places.whatToOrder: BBQ steamboat buffet, grilled stingray, seafood platter.

places.name: Jumbo Palace Seafood Restaurant
places.address: Lot G1, Kompleks Asia City, 88200 KK

redditQuotes.text: Jumbo Palace brings real Sichuan fire to Borneo seafood. The mala crab is intense.
Perfect for late-night eats when most seafood spots have closed.

places.verdict: KK’s late-night seafood king — Sichuan heat meets Borneo-fresh catches until 3 AM.

comparison.best for: Late-night seafood with bold Sichuan flavors
comparison.strengths: Open until 3 AM · Sichuan cooking · Asia City · Bold spice
comparison.what to order: Sichuan mala crab, spicy prawns, chili lobster.

places.whatToOrder: Sichuan mala crab, spicy prawns, chili lobster.

places.name: Fish Market Restaurant
places.address: A-G-2, Block A, Sutera Avenue, 88000 KK

redditQuotes.text: The sauna steamboat at Fish Market is unique. Fresh seafood steamed to perfection.
For upscale experience, Fish Market offers live tanks and refined setting.

places.verdict: Premium KK seafood — live tanks, refined setting, and the famous sauna steamboat.

comparison.best for: Premium live-tank seafood and sauna steamboat
comparison.strengths: Live tanks · Unique sauna steamboat · Sutera Avenue · No pork
comparison.limitations: Higher price · Needs transport from center
comparison.what to order: Sauna steamboat (signature), fresh lobster, seafood platter.

places.whatToOrder: Sauna steamboat (signature), fresh lobster, seafood platter.

places.name: Suang Tain Seafood Restaurant
places.address: No. 16, Block D, Sedco Complex, Kampung Air, 88000 KK

redditQuotes.text: Suang Tain is always crowded but service is fast. The crab is consistently excellent.
Less touristy than Welcome Seafood, arguably better value.

places.verdict: Always packed, always fast — no-frills seafood beloved by locals for fresh crab.

comparison.best for: Fresh crab and prawns in a bustling local atmosphere
comparison.strengths: Popular with locals · Fast service · 2,900+ reviews · Great crab
comparison.limitations: Opens late (2:30 PM) · Crowded · Basic decor
comparison.what to order: Fresh crab (any style), prawns, lobster, oysters.

places.whatToOrder: Fresh crab (any style), prawns, lobster, oysters.

places.name: Gayang Seafood Restaurant

redditQuotes.text: Gayang is the go-to for halal seafood in KK. Waterfront views, chili crab is phenomenal.
Worth the drive. Very fair prices for quality and freshness.

places.verdict: Halal-certified waterfront gem — pick live seafood from display tanks at affordable prices.

comparison.best for: Halal waterfront seafood with live tanks
comparison.strengths: Halal certified · Waterfront · Live tanks · 3,000+ reviews
comparison.limitations: Outside central KK · Limited days · Needs transport
comparison.what to order: Chili crab, grilled fish, fresh clams. Pick from tanks.

places.whatToOrder: Chili crab, grilled fish, fresh clams. Pick from tanks.

places.name: Sembulan Lobster Restaurant
places.address: Com Development, Jalan Mat Salleh, 88100 KK

redditQuotes.text: If lobster is what you want, Sembulan Lobster is the obvious choice.
The steamboat is excellent — great for families wanting interactive dining.

places.verdict: KK’s lobster specialist — great for steamboat too.

comparison.limitations: Closed Wednesdays · Not walkable from center

places.name: New Gaya Seafood Restaurant
places.address: L01-02, Plaza Shell, 29 Jln Tunku Abdul Rahman, 88000 KK

redditQuotes.text: New Gaya does excellent butter prawns — rich, fragrant, and perfectly cooked.
Great for quick seafood lunch without big restaurant crowds.

places.verdict: Hidden gem in Plaza Shell — excellent butter prawns and stir-fried clams.

comparison.best for: Solid everyday seafood in a central location
comparison.strengths: Central · Open daily · Good butter prawns · Reasonable prices
comparison.limitations: Smaller restaurant · Less known to tourists
comparison.what to order: Butter prawns (signature), stir-fried clams, steamed fish.

places.whatToOrder: Butter prawns (signature), stir-fried clams, steamed fish.

places.name: Imperial Seafood Restaurant

redditQuotes.text: Imperial lets you choose from the tank — the freshest possible experience.
DIY hotpot is great fun with a group. Fresh ingredients, comfortable setting.

places.verdict: Live aquarium tanks where you handpick dinner. DIY hotpot adds to the fun.

comparison.what to order: Pick live seafood — lobster, prawns, grouper. Hotpot for groups.

places.whatToOrder: Pick live seafood — lobster, prawns, grouper. Hotpot for groups.

places.name: New Luyang Restaurant
places.address: Shop 1, Jalan Kolam, Luyang Phase 1, 88300 KK

redditQuotes.text: Luyang is the locals’ pick — no tourists, no fuss, properly cooked fresh seafood.
Head to Luyang to eat where Sabahans eat.

places.verdict: Long-standing local favorite away from tourists — classic Chinese seafood done right.

comparison.best for: Authentic local dining away from tourist crowds
comparison.strengths: Local institution · No tourists · Classic Chinese seafood
comparison.limitations: Closed Thursdays · Opens late (2 PM) · Needs transport
comparison.what to order: Steamed fish, chili crab, salted egg prawns.

places.whatToOrder: Steamed fish, chili crab, salted egg prawns.
